note: Reading for claim W7 (batch 15): every occurrence of sana / sinin and of 'am, classed as hardship, ease, or a plain count of time. Strict rule: a verse is classed hardship or ease only if the verse itself says the years were hard or easy. Written after listing the occurrences and before the batch was run. This is one reader's judgement.

comments.sana 5:26: forty years of wandering, forbidden the land
comments.sana 12:47: seven years of planting and harvest. Supporters of the claim read the verse's word for 'continuously' as toil; the years themselves are the fertile ones
comments.sana 20:40: years among the people of Madyan, in a verse about trials. Supporters read this as hardship; the verse does not say the years were hard
comments.sana 26:205: 'if We gave them enjoyment for years': ease, against the claim
comments.sana 29:14: Noah's thousand years among his people. Supporters read this as years of struggle; the verse states a duration
comments.am 9:126: 'they are tried every year once or twice': hardship, against the claim
comments.am 12:49: a year in which people are given rain and press: ease
comments.am 2:259: dead for a hundred years: a duration
comments.am 29:14: 'less fifty years'. Supporters read this as the years of ease after the flood; the verse states a number

generousReading.note: If the three cases that supporters read as hardship are counted that way.
